import os,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
old=b"/srv/lowcost-europa"
out={"gunicorn_env_names":{},"env_files":{},"unit_environment_lines":[],"service_manager_keys":[]}
for proc in Path("/proc").iterdir():
 if not proc.name.isdecimal():continue
 try:
  if (proc/"comm").read_text().strip()!="gunicorn":continue
  if os.readlink(str(proc/"cwd"))!="/srv/projects/lowcost-europa":continue
  env=(proc/"environ").read_bytes()
  out["gunicorn_env_names"][proc.name]=sorted({entry.partition(b"=")[0].decode("utf8","replace") for entry in env.split(b"\0") if old in entry and b"=" in entry})
 except OSError:pass
candidate=["/srv/projects/lowcost-europa/private/systemd-env/lowcost-europa.env","/srv/projects/lowcost-europa/.env","/srv/projects/lowcost-europa/.env.production"]
for path in candidate:
 p=Path(path)
 if not p.is_file() or p.is_symlink():out["env_files"][path]={"exists":False};continue
 raw=p.read_bytes()
 names=[]
 for line in raw.splitlines():
  if old in line:
   field=line.partition(b"=")[0].strip()
   names.append(field.decode("utf8","replace")[:80] if field and all(32<=b<127 for b in field) else "non-simple-key")
 out["env_files"][path]={"exists":True,"old_root_count":raw.count(old),"keys_with_old_value":names}
unit=Path("/etc/systemd/system/lowcost-europa.service")
if unit.is_file():
 lines=unit.read_text(errors="replace").splitlines()
 out["unit_environment_lines"]=[s.split("=",1)[0] for s in lines if s.startswith(("Environment=","EnvironmentFile=","WorkingDirectory="))]
r=subprocess.run(["systemctl","show","lowcost-europa","-p","Environment","--value"],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10)
out["service_manager_keys"]=sorted({x.partition("=")[0][:70] for x in r.stdout.split() if x and not x.startswith("/")})[:40]
print(json.dumps(out,sort_keys=True))
